handback.title: Each criterion lists the code files it changes
handback.summary: Every criterion in a plan names the code files it changes, checked by code.
handback.user_story: Every plan shows which code files each criterion changes, so code can split and fence by them.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each criterion in a plan carries a list of the code files it changes.
acceptance_criteria.words: Each criterion carries a `files` list in the plan's structured output: the code files it changes, at least one.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Plans missing or holding a malformed list are the rejection criterion's cases.

acceptance_criteria.text: The plan check rejects a plan where any criterion lists no file, naming that criterion.
acceptance_criteria.words: Code rejects a plan where a criterion lists none.

edge_cases.case: Empty: the files list is missing or empty.
Bad data: files is one bare path, not a list.
A non-functional requirement lists no file.
A criterion in a split's story lists no file.

acceptance_criteria.text: The plan check accepts a criterion listing a file that does not exist yet.
acceptance_criteria.words: A file it creates counts by its path.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One case: a path no repo holds yet.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner's instructions say a criterion lists every file its behavior needs, never just one.
acceptance_criteria.words: A criterion lists every file its behavior needs, never just one, so a behavior is never cut across stories.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A sentence in the instructions has no edge cases.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner's instructions say work that can be written as code is a criterion like any other.
acceptance_criteria.words: if it can be written as code (infrastructure as code, a setup script), it's a criterion like any other.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A sentence in the instructions has no edge cases.

test_changes.tests/test_plan_shape.py::test_a_feature: Its sample criteria now list their files, which every plan must carry.
test_changes.tests/test_agent.py::test_a_replan_is_ju: Its sample criterion now lists its files, which every plan must carry.
